candidates.description: Summer Lee is an organizer, attorney, and progressive legislator born and raised in the Mon Valley where she attended Woodland Hills public schools before graduating from Penn State and Howard Law. Lee worked as a labor organizer and led voter mobilization for PA Dems, led a successful initiative to transform Woodland Hills School board, and made history beating a 20-year incumbent to become the first Black woman from Western Pennsylvania in the state legislature. Lee later co-founded UNITE, a grassroots organization that transformed regional politics by electing people-powered progressives up and down the ballot. In 2022, Summer was elected to represent Pennsylvania-12, overcoming millions in Republican-funded attacks to again make history as PA’s first Black US Congresswoman. In her first year, Lee brought home an unprecedented >$1 Billion in federal investments for Western PA to build infrastructure and affordable housing, create jobs, combat hunger, and clean our air + water.
candidates.name: SUMMER LEE

candidates.description: Congressman Chris Deluzio is a Thornburg native and Iraq War veteran representing the 17th district of Pennsylvania in the U.S. House. Prior to his election, Chris worked as an attorney and protected voting rights and fair elections as the policy director at Pitt Cyber and previously at the Brennan Center for Justice. He also fought alongside fellow Pitt faculty members and the United Steelworkers as a member of the Pitt Faculty Organizing Committee to secure a faculty union at Pitt—the biggest union election in the country in 2021. In Congress, Chris is committed to fighting for our western Pennsylvania priorities— ensuring strong labor unions, creating good-paying jobs, making stuff here at home, protecting reproductive freedom, standing up for our veterans, and building an economy that works for all. Chris lives with his wife, Zoë, three young children, and their dog, Yankee Doodle, in Aspinwall.
candidates.name: CHRIS DELUZIO

Nick has been a champion for working families passing bills to amend the constitution to guarantee workers’ rights, ban junk fees, help with medical debt repayment, and allow direct deposit of workers comp payment. As State Senator, Nick will continue to make sure that the communities in Allegheny County’s East Hills, South Hills, and Mon Valley receive their fair share of state resources for our local parks, job creation, economic development, first responders, senior citizens and more. A lifelong resident of Allegheny County, Nick graduated from West Mifflin High School before earning degrees at Washington & Jefferson College and Johns Hopkins University. She began her career working alongside adults with intellectual and physical disabilities and later in a mental health residential. Makenzie later supported communities of southwestern Pennsylvania impacted by oil and gas development. Makenzie continues to work with organizations focused on a just transition to a greener economy that centers community solutions. Witnessing firsthand, the impact of corporate greed and exploitation on working class communities, while working directly with individuals, families, and communities directly informs Makenzie’s policy work. Makenzie will advocate for a strong workforce, safe communities, and healthy families.

His parents immigrated to the US, and it was their hard work and commitment to service that inspired him to become a physician. Venkat completed his undergraduate and graduate education at Harvard University, his medical education at Yale University, and his emergency medicine residency at the University of Cincinnati/University Hospital. candidates.description: President Biden and Vice President Harris are delivering results for working families, keeping families safe, and protecting fundamental freedoms that Trump wants to rip away. The Biden-Harris Administration is creating good-paying jobs, lowering costs for families, protecting reproductive rights, keeping our communities safe, and rebuilding the Commonwealth’s infrastructure. Under President Biden, more than $14 billion has been invested in hundreds of specific Pennsylvania infrastructure projects including rebuilding roads and bridges, revitalizing public transit, ports and airports, creating clean water infrastructure, and providing affordable, reliable high-speed internet. candidates.description: Bob Casey was born and raised in Scranton, where he lives today. He brings the Pennsylvania values of hard work and perseverance to his service in the U.S. Senate. He believes that all of us must strive to make Pennsylvania a Commonwealth in life as well as in name, facing our biggest challenges head-on, and facing them together. Bob Casey has dedicated his career to fighting for the most vulnerable among us. His ABLE Act, which allows people with disabilities to save for their future, has been called the most significant disability legislation passed into law since the Americans with Disabilities Act. He worked to cap the cost of insulin at $35 for seniors, and helped pass the PACT Act to provide care to veterans who have suffered after being exposed to toxic burn pits. Throughout his time in public service, Bob Casey has been a steadfast and nationally recognized advocate for Pennsylvania’s children.

candidates.description: Pennsylvania has never elected a woman of color to any statewide executive office — Keir Bradford-Grey will change that, and fight for us as the progressive People’s Attorney. Raised in a proud union household, Keir saw as a young girl the impact the law could have on families like hers, and dedicated herself to using the law to protect people. Now a nationally-recognized state and federal defender for more than two decades, Keir has worked to create a justice system that makes our communities safer. Keir was the first African American to lead public defender offices in Montgomery County—where she was appointed by now-Governor Josh Shapiro—and Philadelphia County, ultimately overseeing a staff of 500+ and a $50M budget. As Attorney General, she’ll use her legal acumen to defend abortion rights and stand up to powerful interests who take advantage of working people, fighting financial scams, gun violence, and more.
candidates.name: KEIR BRADFORD-GREY

candidates.description: A Pittsburgh native, Eugene DePasquale is the former two-term Auditor General of Pennsylvania—the state’s top fiscal watchdog. His leadership exposed nearly $2 billion in waste, fraud and abuse. Eugene has a record of taking on tough fights and delivering real results, including reducing the statewide backlog of thousands of untested rape kits, reforming the child-abuse hotline, securing our voting systems, and holding charter schools accountable to parents and taxpayers. Prior to serving as Auditor, Eugene was a Representative to the General Assembly, where he fought for fairer funding for public schools, investing in clean energy, and making government more transparent. He has a 100% pro-choice lifetime rating from Planned Parenthood and 100% pro-labor record with the PA AFL-CIO. Eugene has a MPA from the University of Pittsburgh, and a JD from Widener University School of Law. He is currently an Adjunct Professor at the University of Pittsburgh.
candidates.name: EUGENE DEPASQUALE

candidates.description: The most experienced prosecutor of all the candidates, Joe is the battle-tested Democrat who has protected Pennsylvania for 24 years. Raised by a Muslim immigrant and a Catholic nurse in a Jewish neighborhood, Joe stands up for everyone. Guided by his law professor, Barack Obama, Joe became a federal prosecutor who protected our kids and took on corruption. He sued Big Pharma over the opioid crisis before becoming the Bucks County Solicitor. Joe’s enforcement of our environmental protections earned him the endorsement of Clean Air Action. His advocacy for abortion rights earned him a target from MAGA extremists. And Joe’s leadership of County Solicitors to stop Trump from stealing the 2020 election earned him — at the recommendation of the Allegheny County Solicitor — PA’s Outstanding Solicitor Award. Joe is proud to be a public school dad and grad who helped kick the “Moms for Liberty” off of his kids’ school board.
candidates.name: JOE KHAN

candidates.description: In one of America’s most violent cities, Jack reduced gun incidents in Chester by 72% and gun homicides by 68%. Jack eliminated the only private prisons in PA, and reduced the prison population by 40%. He created the first environmental crimes unit in Pennsylvania, ensuring the protection of our planet for future generations. Jack fought for women’s rights, fighting the Dobbs decision by signing a pledge along with Attorney General Shapiro vowing to never to prosecute a woman for having an abortion. Jack decriminalized marijuana and sued opioid manufacturers.
